critical_code_review_comments: All four sheet-style modals (meter-install-modal, add-business-modal, have-a-query-pill, profile delete-account-sheet) use `backdrop{flex:1, justifyContent:'flex-end'}` + `sheet{maxHeight:'88%' or unset with KAV}` which pins the sheet to the bottom of the viewport, guaranteeing the grabber and header are visible on any device height. Verified at runtime on 390x844 - all four sheets have y > 0 with grabber + title reachable.

Profile toggles are correctly implemented for independence: local `emailOn`/`pushOn` state is set optimistically then savePrefs fires async; both Switch components have `disabled` unset (only reverted on API failure via `toast()`), so the OTHER switch never dims or becomes unresponsive during the save.

BusinessSwitcherChip.tsx short-circuits with `businesses.length <= 1 => return null`. Runtime check on the current account (2 businesses) confirms the chip renders on BOTH /sites and /reports with kicker 'VIEWING SITES/REPORTS FOR' and a 3-option sheet (All + 2 businesses).
ScreenHeader (src/components/screen.tsx) renders `header-back-button` consistently on all 4 non-home tab screens - verified back navigation to /dashboard from Sites, Reports, Support, Profile.
Dashboard `lower-bills-cta` correctly wires to /quote/new (verified via URL after tap).
